message.content: {"decision": "replace_levels", "pair_ids": ["P3"], "step_ids": ["J1"], "evidence": "Analysis of the original displacement panels reveals two distinct phenomena. First, at index 587 (J1), there is a clear, permanent step change visible across all three axes (N, E, U). The level shifts abruptly and remains at the new offset for the rest of the series; this is retained as a standalone step. Second, around indices 640-645 (J2, J3), there is a transient excursion. In the E-axis, the signal drops sharply at J2 and returns to the previous baseline at J3. Similarly, in the N and U axes, there are abrupt changes at J2/J3 that represent a temporary deviation rather than a permanent shift. This pattern corresponds to candidate pair P3 (J2-J3), which describes a transient event. Candidate pairs involving J1 are rejected because J1 represents a permanent offset."}
